About the job
Donaukanal Speditions AG is a mid-sized freight forwarding and warehousing group with 2,300 employees, 19 branches in Austria, Hungary and Slovakia and our headquarters in Vienna. Our IT runs mostly on premises: two data centres in Vienna and Győr, a Cisco-based WAN connecting all branches, and roughly 600 virtual servers on VMware.

Our Head of IT Infrastructure is on long-term leave. We are looking for an experienced interim manager (Management auf Zeit) to lead the infrastructure department for an interim assignment of six months, maybe longer.

Your responsibilities
- Lead the infrastructure team of 12 people (network, server, storage, workplace) and two service providers
- Keep daily operations stable, including the 24/7 on-call rotation for the warehouse systems
- Drive the consolidation of the Győr data centre into Vienna by mid 2027 (planning, budget, vendor selection)
- Replace the end-of-life core switches and firewalls (Cisco, Palo Alto) at headquarters
- Renegotiate the contracts for WAN, printing and hardware maintenance
- Prepare a decision paper on hybrid cloud: which workloads could move to Microsoft Azure in 2028
- Report monthly to the CIO and the Management Board

What we are looking for
- 10+ years in IT infrastructure, at least 5 years leading infrastructure or operations teams
- Solid knowledge of data centre operations, VMware vSphere, storage (NetApp) and backup (Veeam)
- Good understanding of enterprise networks and security (Cisco, Palo Alto, NAC)
- Experience with data centre moves or consolidations
- Vendor and contract management
- First experience with Azure or other public clouds is welcome but not required
- Fluent German and good English; Hungarian is a plus

The engagement
- Interim assignment, freelance contract directly with us, 6 months with option to extend
- Start: 01.12.2026
- Full time, 5 days per week, on site in Vienna (one home office day per week possible after onboarding)
- Occasional trips to Győr and Bratislava
- Day rate: €1,100 plus travel expenses
